bar.purpose: docdistance measures how far two documents drifted - semantic content distance (SMD, optimal transport over statement embeddings) and structural order distance - with per-statement detail files; for agentic document-conversion and extraction pipelines, and their operators, who must check that a converted, extracted, summarized or rewritten document preserved its source
bar.inputs: two markdown or plain-text documents as file paths or raw strings (field sizes up to roughly 1,100 statements); CLI invocations - a single pair or a --pairs TSV batch, with --json / --result-only / --details-json machine output and the opt-in --markdown / --min-words / --skip-table-fragments / --home options; Python API calls (semantic_distance, structural_distance, DocDistance methods) on a provisioned DOCDISTANCE_HOME
bar.primaryPath: an agent runs a distance command or DocDistance method on a document pair, parses smd/closeness/verdict (or order_gap/structure_closeness) from machine output, and reads the detail file's flags - changed, identical, no_counterpart, displacement_norm/moved, section, targets, summary - to localize what drifted; batch sweeps go through --pairs with one model load
bar.guarantees: for default options the transport plan and every reported smd/order_gap number are bit-identical to v1.1.4; SMD remains a metric (ground cost is a metric, balanced OT, uniform 1/n marginals); all new behaviour is opt-in behind parameters/flags defaulting to the old behaviour, except purely additive detail-file and header fields; machine-mode errors emit a one-line JSON {error, message} object on stdout with exit 1
bar.outOfScope: embedding-model quality and discriminative power; the wmd-wrt-source reranker/NLI pipeline internals (untouched by this change); notebooks, docs/medium drafts and reports; git, versioning and release operations; the pm-tools tracker file format
